strategic_horizon.medium_term_goal: Prove the first real industry benchmark end-to-end: archived original evidence must support no-lookahead Reality + Expectation + Outcome replay across a meaningful cycle, using reusable primitives rather than lithium-specific hacks.
strategic_horizon.short_term_goal: Measure blind-memory novelty decay on matrix-selected first-order replay gaps. Preserve the 668 raw / 610 formal typed / 58 legacy checkpoint, keep search visibility at none, and stop symmetric shard expansion. After supply-side and demand-side translation probes, the next selected gap is UP-CHEMICALS conversion nameplate-to-battery-grade-realized-supply translation.
strategic_horizon.next_big_step: After genuine low-novelty streaks and explicit negative-space review legitimately seal a shard, begin fresh high-capability self-verification/search discovery for that sealed shard, then create claim-scoped evidence tasks and archive original sources for no-lookahead replay.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Stop or re-rank when work no longer materially improves first-order replay coverage, evidence traceability, a seal condition or a main-path blocker. Lead count, shard symmetry, tooling and handoff polish are never objectives by themselves.
parallel_permanent_tracks: Keep current-source collection source-first/archive-now so today's original material does not become tomorrow's recovery gap.
